## ---- THE CHECK THAT DECIDED IT: is `.X` raw integer counts? ----
## cNMF needs counts. `compute_tpm` and the PROTOCOL 3.2 transform are both meaningless on
## normalised input, and NOTHING RAISES -- the pipeline returns numbers either way. This was
## flagged as the primary trap before either file was downloaded, and it fired immediately.
dataset
kang_2018
stephenson_2021_subsampled
## Stephenson evidence: max 7.5257 is a log1p signature; nonzero values repeat exactly
## (0.22479707), which is what per-cell normalisation produces; row sums are ~1259-1458
## rather than integers. `layers` is empty and `.raw` is None, so the counts are not merely
## hidden elsewhere in the file -- they are absent. The pertpy docstring explains why: cells
## were "mapped to a reference atlas of healthy PBMCs from 12 studies with scArches", and the
## distributed object is the processed result of that mapping.
## This does not make Stephenson unusable in principle -- the raw counts exist at the
## original source (Stephenson et al. 2021 Nat Med, Haniffa lab; ArrayExpress E-MTAB-10026
## and covid19cellatlas.org). It makes the PERTPY DISTRIBUTION unusable. Recorded so the
## 669 MB download is not repeated by anyone reading this.
## ---- KANG 2018 STRUCTURE, measured ----
## 24,673 cells x 15,706 genes, no duplicate gene names, 0 cells below 200 counts.
## The donor column is named `replicate`, not `donor` -- a name that would silently pass an
## eyeball check for "is there donor structure" and find nothing.
donor

patient_1488
## 8 donors; cells/donor 1042 - 5090, median 3350.
## Library size min 562, median 1246, max 11816 -- shallow, this is 2017-era 10x chemistry.
## ---- TWO PROPERTIES THAT MAKE IT A CLEAN TEST ----
## 1. CONDITION IS NOT CONFOUNDED WITH DONOR. The stim fraction ranges 0.438 - 0.582 across
##    the eight donors, so every donor contributes both arms in near-equal measure. The
##    IFN-beta activity program is therefore separable from donor identity, which is exactly
##    the confound that would make an activity-recovery claim uninterpretable.
## 2. EVERY CELL TYPE IS PRESENT IN EVERY DONOR (8/8 for all eight types). Contrast the
##    simulator's own DEVELOPMENT fold outer_0, where one identity program had a SINGLE
##    training carrier donor. Kang has no such degeneracy, so it tests a different regime --
##    and the simulator remains the only place that degenerate case can be studied.
cell_type
CD4 T cells
CD14+ Monocytes
B cells
NK cells
CD8 T cells
FCGR3A+ Monocytes
Dendritic cells
Megakaryocytes
## Megakaryocytes reach 1 cell in the thinnest donor: a genuine rare population, and the
## natural real-data test for rare-program recovery.
## ---- WHAT KANG CAN AND CANNOT ANSWER ----
## CAN: does cNMF recover a KNOWN ACTIVITY PROGRAM? The interferon-beta response is induced,
## strong, and carries a per-cell `label` (stim/ctrl, 12358/12315). An inferred program that
## tracks that label is checkable against a recorded fact rather than against a judgement
## about whether a gene list "looks biological" -- which is the unfalsifiable reasoning this
## programme exists to avoid. This is the closest thing to ground truth real data offers, and
## it fills the gap that every identity-only dataset leaves.
## CANNOT: test feature A well. EIGHT DONORS IS THIN. Two outer folds gives 4 train / 4 test
## before inner folds, against the simulator's 24. D008 already established that donor COUNT
## is the dominant effect (t = +4.30) and per-donor leakage is not (t = -0.37), so a
## donor-blocking result at n = 8 would be measuring the thing D008 says dominates. Kang is
## not the dataset for A's premise and should not be used to claim anything about it.
